notes: Drag a script onto the prompter. A Word, RTF, text or web file dragged from the Finder onto the script opens as a new tab (or fills an empty one), with its bold, italic and colour, the same as Open…. Before, a dropped file could replace the prompter window with the file itself. A paste with no formatting says so. A preview window (Gmail's attachment preview, a PDF viewer) puts only the words on the clipboard, never bold, italic or colour, so nothing can bring them back. After a script-sized plain paste the prompter now says so: download the file and drag it onto the script for the formatting.
